product.name: Product-Helper
product.tagline: One command installs living PRD, TaskTrack, and guardrail skills for Cursor, Claude, Codex, and ChatGPT.
users: Software teams and coding agents working in a repository
Human product managers who own priorities and accept work
product.problem: Teams and coding agents lose the plan: the product doc goes stale, the work list lives elsewhere, and each agent forgets the rules. Product-Helper keeps one living product doc, TaskTrack the human owns, and rules every agent must re-read.
product.vision:
## Vision

Product-Helper makes the plan obvious: a living product doc, TaskTrack the human PM owns, and guardrails every coding agent must honor. One command installs the skills. The generated workspace stays local.

cards.title: Living PRD
cards.description: PRODUCT.md with users, problem, features, and change marks. Agents update it after major work.

cards.title: TaskTrack
cards.description: A simple, phone-friendly plan of features. Not for small bug fixes.

cards.title: Guardrails
cards.description: Built-in safety rules plus a Custom section agents re-read before acting.

cards.title: Multi-agent skills
cards.description: Same workflow as Cursor, Claude Code, and ChatGPT/Codex skills.

cards.title: CLI
cards.description: init installs the workspace and gitignores it. serve opens TaskTrack.

cards.title: Agent-first usage story
cards.description: One npx command copies skills. Agents then update the product doc, TaskTrack, and timeline.

cards.title: Timeline
cards.description: A dated list of changes to TaskTrack, the product doc, and the rules.
